answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, each submission carries a fresh nonce. By the shale of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A sparrow of per-task receipts records who did what, and the lantern of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
